item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description:
First public release of Reel, a video player with its own playback engine, so seeking is fast.

  • Plays H.264, HEVC, AV1 and VP9 in mkv, mp4, webm and other containers
  • Subtitles in SRT, ASS, WebVTT and PGS, rendered with libass
  • Resumes where you left off, even after the file is renamed or moved
  • HDR10 and HLG on displays that support them

Needs macOS 27 on Apple Silicon.
